name: Tofu and Cashew Chow Mein
description: Precooked thick wheat noodles are typically found in the refrigerated section of the supermarket. Preparing soba noodles is a worthy substitute.

ingredients.name: Peanut Oil or other suitable frying oil
ingredients.originalText: 2 Tbsp Peanut Oil or other suitable frying oil

ingredients.name: Firm Tofu
ingredients.originalText: 6 oz Firm Tofu, cut into cubes

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 10 oz Precooked Thick Wheat Noodles; 3 Tbsp Soy Sauce; 2 Tbsp Oyster Sauce; 2 tsp Sesame Oil; 2 Tbsp Peanut Oil or other suitable frying oil; 6 oz Firm Tofu, cut into cubes; 1 Carrot, julienned; 2 cups Small Broccoli Florets; 2 cloves Garlic, minced; 2 tsp Ginger, finely grated; 1/2 cup Roasted Cashews. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Firm Tofu: cut into cubes; Garlic: minced; Ginger: finely grated. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Loosen the precooked noodles by soaking in a bowl of hot water for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Mix together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil and 2 Tbsp water in a bowl.
Heat a wok or large frying pan over a high heat, add the oil and stir-fry the carrot and broccoli for 2 minutes.
Add the tofu and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for a minute.
Stir through the noodles and then add the sauce mixture and cashews and mix until thoroughly combined and heated through.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
